text:
Final concrete review corrections; preserve existing operations, scopes, writer, cleanup, requirements and all limits.
The three extract resultType Candidate.kind enums currently demand invented classifications (consentControl, blockerText, productLink, name/description/price) not present in Browser records. Replace these enums with plain observed strings copied from the authoritative record kind; classify business meaning only in the downstream interpret task. Remove duplicate sourceRecordText because text already preserves the observed content. Do not synthesize constants or infer defaults inside extraction. Preserve observed reference/actions and URLs where their consumer needs them, and process every page through each then flatten.
Make consent_branch.condition explicitly require a non-null decide_initial_consent.consentReference AND not isCaptchaOrBlocked. A hasConsentControl boolean alone cannot establish a valid reference. The action remains literal activate.
In interpret_product_detail, bind candidate as an explicit object containing only the current item's rank and URL, so the search title cannot act as fallback. Keep product facts from the visited page.
In assemble_workbook_tsv bind productRows directly to output source visit_each_product, port product, the declared collected product array. Keep its remaining needed inputs and real writer/output unchanged. Return a complete corrected plan with the same accepted requirements.
